label: capacity
rule: plausible bed count that agrees with the record's own text

label: number of doctors
rule: plausible count, not 1 doctor at a large facility (cleaned)

label: official website
rule: the facility's own domain (not a directory, social or other organisation)

label: description
rule: a description of the facility, not extractor meta-text, a bare label or truncated scrape

label: email
rule: parsed address, not a Cloudflare placeholder

label: coordinates
rule: coordinates within 50 km of the record's own postcode centre

label: official phone
rule: valid Indian number not held by records in 3+ cities (directory line)

label: postcode
rule: 6-digit postcode found in the India Post directory

label: facility type
rule: one of hospital / clinic / dentist / doctor / pharmacy
